_doc: Per-reference defaults. A reference that already renders a convincing, recognisable face makes the identity overlay counter-productive: it drops a photographic head into an illustration and flattens the idiom. Flat-vector and posterised references behave this way; painterly and texture-led ones still need the overlay to hold the likeness. surreal_with_face.py reads this and applies no_face_overlay unless the flag is given explicitly on the command line.

posterizing.jpg.note: flat vector planes; keeps the face readable on its own

posterizing2.jpg.note: continuous-line figure; overlay buries the linework

red-roses-blue-water.jpg.note: screen-print shapes; face survives the stylisation

underwater.jpg.note: flat vector scene; overlay breaks the graphic read
